## Authorization

- [ ] Authentication checked at server boundary.
- [ ] Ownership and membership verified for every resource.
- [ ] Viewer/read-only permissions enforced by server.
- [ ] Expired, revoked, and cross-resource tokens rejected.

## Input and execution safety

- [ ] Inputs validated and size-limited.
- [ ] User code and markup isolated from application processes.
- [ ] Time, memory, filesystem, process, and network limits reviewed.
- [ ] Upload types, ownership, and object paths validated.
- [ ] Logs do not disclose secrets or private content.

## Verification

List tests, negative cases, scans, manual checks, and unresolved risks. Never label a control verified without evidence.
